title: Software modification - Vaporize managed user services

stateResults.summary: The Vaporize boundary had pre-existing Info.plist and Package.resolved changes; the exact-file service slice excludes both.
Added typed Pkl service declarations, a CommonProcess-backed service manager, Windows Task Scheduler and macOS LaunchAgent adapters, and the Vaporize service command family.

VaporizeCLI builds on Windows; four service-management tests and three project-model tests pass; focused Swift format lint passes; and the built CLI resolves the fused-inference proving config through the read-only logs action.

notes: The shared service-registration implementation contains no conditional-compilation platform branches and emits CLI output through CommonLog.
The command is opt-in; explicit service mutation actions are the feature boundary, so no additional feature flag is required.
System service scope stays rejected until Vaporize has an explicit elevation and authorization contract.
